trailhead_today: Mount Si Trailhead (DNR, Mt. Si Road)
trailhead_elev_official: 660 ft (Mountaineers route page; no DNR figure found)
summit_elev_official: 4,167 ft NGVD29 (Wikipedia citing Peakbagger/GNIS); Mountaineers gives Haystack 4,180 ft

figures.fact: WTA: 8.0 mi roundtrip, 3,150 ft gain, highest point 3,900 ft (trail end meadow, not the Haystack summit).
Mountaineers main trail: 3,150 ft gain, high point 3,900 ft, ends in the meadow below the Haystack.
Mountaineers: Mount Si Haystack (4,180 ft) scramble, 8 miles round trip, 3,360 ft elevation gain.
Wikipedia (citing Peakbagger): the four-mile Mount Si trail climbs 3,500 ft to the summit ridge; Haystack is class 3.

evidence.fact: Haystack (4,180 ft) scramble from the 660 ft trailhead: 8 mi round trip, 3,360 ft of elevation gain.
Mount Si trail climbs 3,500 ft to the summit ridge; summit elevation 4,167 ft (Peakbagger).

closures: DNR alert: Mount Si Trailhead closed Tuesday Nov 3 for parking-area grading (one day); trails open.
note: Stored 3,150 is the published gain to the hiking trail's end at 3,900 ft (WTA + Mountaineers agree), not to the 4,167 ft summit the pin marks. Summit figures 3,360 and 3,500 agree within 10%; Mountaineers figure is route-precise (names the Haystack).

trailhead_today: Skyline Divide Trailhead (#678, end of FR 37) -- road CLOSED until further notice
summit_elev_official: 7,515 ft (Mountaineers Hadley Peak route page high point; no GNIS/NGS page opened)

figures.fact: Mountaineers: Hadley Peak scramble, 13.0 mi with 4,700 ft of gain; high point 7,515 ft. Whole-outing figure.
WTA Skyline Divide hike only: 9.0 mi roundtrip, 2,500 ft gain, highest point 6,563 ft (sixth knoll, not Hadley).

closures: WTA 6.3.26: Deadhorse Creek Road (FR 37) closed until further notice due to flood damage. A 2023 Mountaineers listing also noted a washout.
note: No opened page gives a one-way gain to Hadley Peak from the Skyline Divide trailhead; 4,700 is a 13-mile outing total with ridge ups and downs. Summit pin 7,515 agrees with Mountaineers. Stored 2,818 matches no published figure. stevensong.com unreadable (extension permission).

trailhead_today: Hannegan Pass Trailhead (end of FR 32 / Ruth Creek Road)
summit_elev_official: No published top elevation for this 90 ft pitch; the 5,000 ft pin is the top of 700 ft Ellation (stephabegg.com)

figures.fact: Mamie Peak approach from the Hannegan Pass trailhead to the base of the crag: about an hour with 1200' of gain.

evidence.fact: Woodland Critter Christmas: Trad, Alpine, 90 ft; a single-pitch climb on a buttress near the base of Ellation.
Ellation is a 700 ft, 8-pitch route on Mamie Peak; top of route 5,000 ft (summit of Mamie 6,108 ft).

closures: Abegg (2018): washout just before the Hannegan Pass trailhead, park before it. WTA Hannegan page shows no current alert.
note: Stored 1,200 is the published approach gain to the crag base (MP). The 5,000 ft top pin is the top of Ellation, not this 90 ft pitch near Ellation's base; move it to the crag. Stored gain is right for this route.

trailhead_today: Mowich Lake (SR 165) -- NO public access: SR165/Fairfax Bridge closed to vehicles, bikes and pedestrians, no alternate route
summit_elev_official: Liberty Cap 14,112 ft (Wikipedia, Mount Rainier subsidiary peaks)
closures: NPS Carbon River and Mowich page: no public access to Carbon River & Mowich Lake from SR 165; Fairfax Bridge closed (WSDOT 4/22/25), no alternate route.
note: No opened page gives a one-way gain for the Edmunds Headwall from Mowich Lake (cascadeclimber.com TR and Mountaineers Mowich Face listing have none). Summit pin 14,112 matches Liberty Cap. Bigger issue: the pinned trailhead cannot be reached at all today.

trailhead_today: Andrews Creek Trailhead (#504, end of FR 51 pavement)

figures.fact: WTA Andrews Creek trail only (to Boundary Trail): 31.0 mi roundtrip, 4,000 ft gain, highest point 6,700 ft; not to the summit.

closures: None found on WTA. Gilbertson (2018) notes the Thirtymile trailhead road was washed out then.
note: Gilbertson (countryhighpoints.com, 2018) calls Andrews Creek an 18-mile approach with the most gain of the three approaches but gives no figure. No opened page gives a one-way gain to Amphitheater from Andrews Creek; stored 3,000 is far too low for that start and may belong to a Cathedral Lakes camp start, unconfirmed.

closures: None found. CascadeClimbers TR (July 2025): Downey approach straightforward, trail work done all the way to Bachelor Creek.
note: Middle Gunsight East Face (7 pitches, 5.10d) is reached from Downey Creek via Bachelor Creek, Cub Lake, Itswoot Ridge and the Chikamin Glacier, a multi-day approach (CascadeClimbers 108169). No opened page gives a one-way gain or an official Middle Peak elevation. SummitPost skipped (403).

trailhead_today: North Fork Quinault River Trailhead (North Fork Road; may close in winter)
trailhead_elev_official: 519 ft (NPS North Fork Quinault River Trail page: elevation change 519 to 3,602 ft)
summit_elev_official: 6,695 ft (trailcatjim.com trip report title; no GNIS page opened)

figures.fact: Brisbine 2020, six days via Low Divide and Seattle Basin: approximately 42 miles traveled, 9,300 feet gained and lost.
Summit day from the 4,900 ft Seattle Basin camp: reached Meany summit in 5.6 hours with 2,200 feet gained.

evidence.fact: North Fork Quinault River Trail: 16 miles to Low Divide, elevation change 519 feet to 3,602 feet.

closures: NPS: North Fork Road may be closed during winter; the 16-Mile ford can be hazardous or impassable at high water.
note: Trailhead pin (515) agrees with NPS 519. Stored 2,500 is not a trailhead figure; it is near the 2,200 ft summit-day gain from a Seattle Basin high camp (one source only, and not equal), so it probably belongs to a camp start. No one-way trailhead-to-summit figure published.
